Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/18/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 67 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Midwifery until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 67 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the State Board of Midwifery until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
